name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v2527: Two static walks both returned zero writers for all four stores and both were measuring themselves. write_witness watches the writes happen instead. Its own demo caught it blind - patching only builtins.open missed io.open which this codebase uses everywhere, so a module whose entire job is counting writers reported zero for a store it had just watched being written. It also named a module that does not exist, because abspath of stdin lands inside the tree. And the write that matters never opens the store - these stores are written to a tmp file and moved, so watching only open would see the tmp and never the store. It is an instrument, not a measurement.
